---- MODULE FlashWithMutex ----
EXTENDS FlashWithMutexDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL ProofTools == INSTANCE TLAPS

AuxSmall == /\ RpMsg \in [NODE -> [Cmd : RP_CMD]]
            /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd \in SHWB_CMD
THEOREM AuxSmallInvariant == Spec => []AuxSmall
<1>1. Init => AuxSmall
  BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, AuxSmall, RP_CMD, SHWB_CMD
<1>2. AuxSmall /\ [Next]_vars => AuxSmall'
  BY ProofTools!SMTT("r20") DEF AuxSmall, RP_CMD, SHWB_CMD, ReqCmd, vars, pendVars, fwdVars, InvNodes, NoOtherSharers, ProcHomeInvalid, ProcHomeInvalidMarked, Store, PI_Remote, PI_Local_Get_Get, PI_Local_Get_Put, PI_Local_GetX_GetX, PI_Local_GetX_PutX_Inv, PI_Local_GetX_PutX_Grant, PI_Local_GetX_PutX, PI_Remote_PutX, PI_Local_PutX, PI_Remote_Replace, PI_Local_Replace, NI_Nak, NI_Nak_Clear, NI_Local_Get_Nak, NI_Local_Get_Get, NI_Local_Get_Put, NI_Remote_Nak, NI_Remote_Get_Put, NI_Local_GetX_Nak, NI_Local_GetX_GetX, NI_Local_GetX_PutX_Dirty, NI_Local_GetX_PutX_Grant, NI_Local_GetX_PutX_Inv, NI_Local_GetX_PutX, NI_Remote_GetX_PutX, NI_Local_Put, NI_Remote_Put, NI_Local_PutXAcksDone, NI_Remote_PutX, NI_Inv, NI_InvAck_More, NI_InvAck_Last, NI_InvAck, NI_Wb, NI_FAck, NI_ShWb, NI_Replace, Next
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, ProofTools!PTL DEF Spec

AuxRich ==
 /\ TypeOK
 /\ \A n \in NODE : Proc[n].CacheState # "CACHE_I" => Proc[n].CacheData \in DATA
 /\ \A n \in NODE : UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"} => UniMsg[n].Data \in DATA
 /\ (WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" => WbMsg.Data \in DATA)
 /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" => /\ ShWbMsg.Data \in DATA /\ ShWbMsg.Proc \in NODE)
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM TypeCorrect == Spec => []TypeOK
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_FlashProtocol/FlashWithMutex_TypeCorrect.tla
<1>1. Init => AuxRich
  BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU
<1>2. AuxRich /\ [Next]_vars => AuxRich'
  <2>1. AuxRich => AuxRich
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, ReqCmd
  <2>2. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE, NEW data \in DATA
         PROVE AuxRich /\ Store(src, data) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, Store, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>3. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE, NEW c \in ReqCmd
         PROVE AuxRich /\ PI_Remote(src, c) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Remote, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>4. AuxRich /\ PI_Local_Get_Get => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Local_Get_Get
  <2>5. AuxRich /\ PI_Local_Get_Put => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Local_Get_Put, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>6. AuxRich /\ PI_Local_GetX_GetX => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Local_GetX_GetX
  <2>7. AuxRich /\ PI_Local_GetX_PutX => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Local_GetX_PutX, fwdVars, PI_Local_GetX_PutX_Inv, PI_Local_GetX_PutX_Grant, InvNodes
  <2>8. ASSUME NEW dst \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ PI_Remote_PutX(dst) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Remote_PutX, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>9. AuxRich /\ PI_Local_PutX => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Local_PutX, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>10. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ PI_Remote_Replace(src) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Remote_Replace, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>11. AuxRich /\ PI_Local_Replace => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, PI_Local_Replace, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>12. ASSUME NEW dst \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Nak(dst) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Nak, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>13. AuxRich /\ NI_Nak_Clear => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Nak_Clear, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>14. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Local_Get_Nak(src) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Local_Get_Nak, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>15. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Local_Get_Get(src) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Local_Get_Get
  <2>16. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Local_Get_Put(src) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Local_Get_Put, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>17. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE, NEW dst \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Nak(src, dst) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Nak, pendVars
  <2>18. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE, NEW dst \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => AuxRich'
    <3>1. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (Home \in NODE)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>2. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (Proc \in [NODE -> [ProcCmd : NODE_CMD, InvMarked : BOOLEAN,
                          CacheState : CACHE_STATE, CacheData : DataU]])'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>3. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (Dir \in [Pending : BOOLEAN, Local : BOOLEAN, Dirty : BOOLEAN,
                HeadVld : BOOLEAN, HeadPtr : NodeU, ShrVld : BOOLEAN,
                ShrSet : SUBSET NODE, InvSet : SUBSET NODE])'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>4. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (MemData \in DATA)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>5. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (UniMsg \in [NODE -> [Cmd : UNI_CMD, Proc : NodeU, Data : DataU]])'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>6. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (InvMsg \in [NODE -> [Cmd : INV_CMD]])'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>7. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (RpMsg  \in [NODE -> [Cmd : RP_CMD]])'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>8. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (WbMsg   \in [Cmd : WB_CMD, Proc : NodeU, Data : DataU])'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>9. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (ShWbMsg \in [Cmd : SHWB_CMD, Proc : NodeU, Data : DataU])'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars

    <3>11. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (CurrData \in DATA)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>12. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (PrevData \in DATA)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>13. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (PendReqSrc \in NodeU)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>14. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (PendReqCmd \in UniU)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>15. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (Collecting \in BOOLEAN)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>16. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (FwdCmd \in UNI_CMD)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>17. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (FwdSrc \in NodeU)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>18. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (\A n \in NODE : Proc[n].CacheState # "CACHE_I" => Proc[n].CacheData \in DATA)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>19. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => (\A n \in NODE : UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"} => UniMsg[n].Data \in DATA)'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars
    <3>20. AuxRich /\ NI_Remote_Get_Put(src, dst) => ((WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" => WbMsg.Data \in DATA))'
      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars

      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Remote_Get_Put, pendVars

         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Local_GetX_Nak(src) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Local_GetX_Nak, pendVars, fwdVars
  <2>20. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE
         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Local_GetX_GetX(src) => AuxRich'
    BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Local_GetX_GetX

         PROVE AuxRich /\ NI_Local_GetX_PutX(src) => AuxRich'

      BY ProofTools!SMTT("r10") DEF AuxRich, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU, NI_Local_GetX_PutX, fwdVars, NI_Local_GetX_PutX_Dirty, NI_Local_GetX_PutX_Grant, NI_Local_GetX_PutX_Inv, InvNodes, NoOtherSharers, ProcHomeInvalidMarked, pendVars, ProcHomeInvalid
